observations: Photo 0 and 1 show a black DSLR camera body with 'Nikon' and 'D3300' printed on the front, sitting atop a matching retail box labeled 'D3300 18-55 VR II Kit'.
A detachable lens marked 'Nikon AF-S DX NIKKOR 18-55mm VR' is placed beside the camera in both photos.
Background shows unrelated flash units (Godox TT520, Yongnuo) and other boxed electronics, suggesting a shop/stall setting.
No photo shows the camera powered on, no LCD screen view, no lens cap removed to inspect glass, no shutter count, no memory card slot or battery compartment.
Lens front cap is on in photo 1; in photo 0 the lens mount end is visible but no clear glass inspection.

claims.evidence: Matches known D3300 spec sheet, but no photo shows sensor or any image output to confirm sensor is intact/functional.
No video or burst-shot evidence provided.
No focus test or live demonstration shown.

claims.claim: Implied kit includes lens and original box
claims.evidence: Photo 0 and 1 show camera, lens, and matching branded box together.

risks.risk: Shutter count / mechanical wear not visible, could be near end-of-life
risks.proof: Photo or screenshot of shutter count from a shutter-count checking tool or menu display

risks.risk: Sensor dust, scratches, or dead pixels
risks.proof: A test photo taken against plain white/blue sky background

risks.risk: Lens glass condition (fungus, scratches, haze) not visible under cap
risks.proof: Close-up photo of front and rear lens elements with cap off, lit from an angle
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with optical flaws

risks.risk: LCD screen and viewfinder functionality unknown
risks.proof: Photo/video of camera powered on showing live view and menu

risks.risk: Battery, charger, and memory card inclusion not confirmed
risks.proof: Photo of all included accessories laid out together
risks.if_unproven: priced as body+lens only, no accessories

risks.risk: Box could be a display prop not matched to this exact unit (serial mismatch)
risks.proof: Photo of serial number on camera body matched to serial number on box
risks.if_unproven: priced as generic used body, box not counted as provenance

proof_requests: Power-on photo/video showing LCD screen and menu active
Close-up of serial number on camera body and matching number on box
Test shot (sample photo) taken with the camera to verify sensor/image quality
Close-up of lens front/rear elements without cap, checking for fungus or scratches
Photo of shutter count via menu or external checker tool
Photo of all accessories included (battery, charger, strap, memory card, cables)
response.reason: Camera and lens are clearly identified by visible branding as a Nikon D3300 DSLR kit, so it can be priced, but with no proof of power-on function, sensor condition, lens clarity, or shutter count, it must be priced at worst-case condition until further proof is supplied.
